authority_note: This snapshot is raw price history and a registration INPUT, never a generated output. Its authority block rides here rather than on every price row because the registered digest B_SOURCE_PREFIX_SHA256 covers exactly [open, high, low, close, volume] -- adding authority columns would break the registration this file exists to preserve. Same precedent as data/stock_identity/ohlcv/manifest.json.
immutability: This file and its parquet are written ONCE and never regenerated. data/stock_identity/ is program-owned and is not touched by scripts/fetch_basket_ohlcv.py. Any future change requires a fresh W1-A1 registration.

what: Immutable program-owned snapshot of the W1-A1 registered B (Barrick Mining, EDGAR CIK 756894) OHLCV prefix, 2014-01-02..2026-08-13 (3172 rows).
why: The registration pinned an exact digest over data/baskets/ohlcv/B.parquet on the premise that only post-asof appends move that file. That premise is false: scripts/fetch_basket_ohlcv.py re-downloads the FULL history nightly via yf.download(auto_adjust=True) and merges new.combine_first(prior) (new wins), so the vendor's recomputed cumulative adjustment factor rewrites the historical prefix on every collection night. The registered plane therefore cannot live on a nightly-rewritten file.
